sets.name: Button
sets.description:
The system's action control. It renders a real `<button>` — or an `<a role="button">` when `href` is set — so the element the user actually gets, and the keyboard behaviour that comes with it, follows the props rather than the styling. Everything else about a button is ranking: `variant` says how much weight this action carries against the others on screen.

Tag: al-button

Props
- isDisabled: boolean — Disabled attribute
- isPill: boolean — Pill shape
- label — Indicates the aria label to apply to the button.
- size: sm | lg — Size variant
  - omitted: renders the default 40px control with 14px text
- variant: neutral | bare | secondary | tertiary — Style variant — an EMPHASIS axis, strongest to weakest.
  - default: renders the primary button, the strongest emphasis

Slots
- (default) — The button text content.
- after — Content to display after the button text, typically an icon.
- before — Content to display before the button text, typically an icon.

Accessibility
- element: <button>

Docs: https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/components/button/

sets.name: Checkbox
sets.description:
Tag: al-checkbox

Props
- hideLabel: boolean — Hide label?
- isChecked: boolean — Checked attribute
- isDisabled: boolean — Disabled attribute
- isError: boolean — Error state
- isIndeterminate: boolean — Indeterminate state

Slots
- (default) — The component content that appears next to the checkbox
- error — If content is slotted, it will display in place of the errorNote property
- field-note — If content is slotted, it will display in place of the fieldNote property

Accessibility
- element: <div>
- key Enter: Toggles the checked state. Space is the native <input type="checkbox"> activation and needs no handler here.
- focus: The native input takes focus; the visible indicator is a 1px primary border edge plus a 3px soft halo of the same hue (--al-theme-color-border-primary-default / -weak), with outline: none. The solid edge carries the 3:1 WCAG non-text contrast - the halo is decoration.

sets.name: Combobox
sets.description:
Component: al-combobox

A text input with a filtered listbox popup, following the WAI-ARIA
combobox/listbox/option pattern. Reuses `al-dropdown-panel` for the popup
surface, `al-list`/`al-list-item` for options, and `al-input` for the
field — the same primitives `al-select` and `al-search` are built on —
rather than reinventing popover positioning or option rendering.

Filtering is either automatic (`filterMode="auto"`, the default —
`items` is filtered client-side by a case-insensitive substring match on
`label`) or manual (`filterMode="manual"` — the consumer listens for
`onComboboxFilter` and reassigns `items` themselves, e.g. from an async
API call).

Tag: al-combobox

Props
- hideLabel: boolean — Hide the label?
- isActiveDropdown: boolean — Is the listbox popup open?
- isDisabled: boolean — The combobox's disabled attribute
- isError: boolean — Error state
- isOptional: boolean — Optional state

Slots
- error — If content is slotted, it will display in place of the errorNote property
- field-note — If content is slotted, it will display in place of the fieldNote property

Accessibility
- element: <div>
- key ArrowDown: Opens the dropdown and highlights the first enabled option; when already open, moves the highlight down one.
- key ArrowUp: Opens the dropdown and highlights the last enabled option; when already open, moves the highlight up one.
- key Home: Highlights the first enabled option. Only while the dropdown is open.
- key End: Highlights the last enabled option. Only while the dropdown is open.
- key Enter: Selects the highlighted option. Only when the dropdown is open and something is highlighted.
- key Escape: Closes the dropdown without selecting.
- key Tab: Closes the dropdown and lets focus move on.
- focus: Focus stays on the text input for the whole interaction; the highlighted option is indicated by aria-activedescendant, not by moving focus.

standalone.name: Combobox/Default
standalone.description:
Component: al-combobox

A text input with a filtered listbox popup, following the WAI-ARIA
combobox/listbox/option pattern. Reuses `al-dropdown-panel` for the popup
surface, `al-list`/`al-list-item` for options, and `al-input` for the
field — the same primitives `al-select` and `al-search` are built on —
rather than reinventing popover positioning or option rendering.

Filtering is either automatic (`filterMode="auto"`, the default —
`items` is filtered client-side by a case-insensitive substring match on
`label`) or manual (`filterMode="manual"` — the consumer listens for
`onComboboxFilter` and reassigns `items` themselves, e.g. from an async
API call).

Tag: al-combobox

Props
- hideLabel: boolean — Hide the label?
- isActiveDropdown: boolean — Is the listbox popup open?
- isDisabled: boolean — The combobox's disabled attribute
- isError: boolean — Error state
- isOptional: boolean — Optional state

Slots
- error — If content is slotted, it will display in place of the errorNote property
- field-note — If content is slotted, it will display in place of the fieldNote property

Accessibility
- element: <div>
- key ArrowDown: Opens the dropdown and highlights the first enabled option; when already open, moves the highlight down one.
- key ArrowUp: Opens the dropdown and highlights the last enabled option; when already open, moves the highlight up one.
- key Home: Highlights the first enabled option. Only while the dropdown is open.
- key End: Highlights the last enabled option. Only while the dropdown is open.
- key Enter: Selects the highlighted option. Only when the dropdown is open and something is highlighted.
- key Escape: Closes the dropdown without selecting.
- key Tab: Closes the dropdown and lets focus move on.
- focus: Focus stays on the text input for the whole interaction; the highlighted option is indicated by aria-activedescendant, not by moving focus.

Docs: https://altitude.pages.dev/docs/components/combobox/
